notes.text: 폐기가 허약하면 피로·약한 말소리·숨참이 나타난다고 봄
장부 이론의 전제는 근거중심의학으로 검증되지 않음

source: Wikipedia Zang-fu (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zang-fu): Lung governs qi and breathing; takes in clear air; combines inhaled qi with food essence into pectoral qi (zong qi); disperses and descends; lung qi deficiency -> fatigue, weak speech, shortness of breath; assumptions not verified by evidence-based medicine
